package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// TaskFileStorageRepoPG loads task starter-file references.
type TaskFileStorageRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// ListByTask returns all task file storage entries ordered by type/order.
func (r TaskFileStorageRepoPG) ListByTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskFileStorage, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT task_id, type, filestorage_id, "order"
FROM task_filestorage
WHERE task_id = $1
ORDER BY type, "order", filestorage_id
`, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var items []domain.TaskFileStorage
	for rows.Next() {
		var item domain.TaskFileStorage
		if err := rows.Scan(&item.TaskID, &item.Type, &item.FileStorageID, &item.Order); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, item)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if items == nil {
		return []domain.TaskFileStorage{}, nil
	}
	return items, nil
}

func (r TaskFileStorageRepoPG) ReplaceForTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string, items []domain.TaskFileStorage) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM task_filestorage WHERE task_id = $1`, taskID); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO task_filestorage (task_id, type, filestorage_id, "order")
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
`, taskID, item.Type, item.FileStorageID, item.Order); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

var _ interface {
	ListByTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) ([]domain.TaskFileStorage, error)
	ReplaceForTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string, items []domain.TaskFileStorage) error
} = TaskFileStorageRepoPG{}
